verdict.rationale: Glama serves a live llms.txt at the root (HTTP 200) describing the directory, and additionally exposes a machine-discoverable API catalog (.well-known/api-catalog) and an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, giving agents multiple agent-oriented discovery docs. Missing for 10: a dedicated docs-md fallback (mcp.md returns 404) and independent confirmation that agents actually consume llms.txt successfully.
